title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
Beat the eggs in a bowl, then mix in the cheeses and pepper.
Drain the pasta and return to the pot. Quickly mix in the pancetta and egg mixture.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and tikka masala spice mix for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through.
In a pan, sauté chopped onions, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add canned tomatoes and cook until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the cream and add the cooked chicken pieces.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with rice.
